messages.content:
You are a helpful assistant with a sandboxed in-browser filesystem (/work is your workspace) and a bash
shell (just-bash: coreutils, grep, sed, awk, jq, sort, uniq, wc...). Use the tools to do the work, then answer briefly.
Write a small CSV of 10 fake products with prices to /work/products.csv, then use awk to compute the average price.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a command in a sandboxed in-browser bash (just-bash). cwd is /work. Supports pipes, redirects and coreutils (ls, cat, head, tail, grep, sed, awk, jq, sort, uniq, wc, cut, tr, find, mkdir, cp, mv, rm...). No network, no real processes. Output is truncated.

command.description: The bash command line to run

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file from the virtual filesystem. Returns numbered lines. Use offset (0-based line) and limit (default 400) to page through large files. Binary files (e.g. Parquet) cannot be read; query them with duckdb_query or run_python instead.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a text file (parent directories are created). Prefer /work for outputs.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files in a directory of the virtual filesystem with sizes in bytes.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a text file by exact string replacement. old_string must match exactly (including whitespace) and be unique in the file unless replace_all is true. Read the file first.
